routes.name: R_BASELINE_ONLY
routes.retired_because: B(73/50)<0 with no Taylor remainder, so the baseline alone cannot prove A>1. This limitation is acknowledged by the manuscript.

C9000354.statement: Independently certify a refutation or verification of the manuscript's load-bearing new mechanism at publishable target level.

C_PROFILE_CLASSIFICATION.statement: The manuscript's full cubic-torus profile and equality classification.

L_CLASSICAL_STRUCTURE.statement: Classical connectedness, genus and curvature-area structure in the identity-group case.

L_GEOMETRIC_SETUP.statement: Reflection and strict coordinate normals place nonstandard minimizers in the stated monotone vertex patterns.

L_TWO_VOLUME.statement: Endpoint standardness implies the profile and equality classification on every smooth model branch.

L_EARLY_EXCLUSIONS.statement: The four-vertex pattern at both endpoints and the three-vertex pattern at 4pi/81 are excluded.

L_FLUX.statement: Regularity, absolute-continuity area substitution, coarea and the flux identity hold for the geometric slices.

L_PARAMETER_RANGE.statement: The remaining three-vertex minimizer at V=1/pi has .64<=h<=2.25 and s>=t(h).

C_NESTING_OBSTRUCTION.statement: Every nested-slice family satisfying the explicit flux, coarea and planar-type hypotheses with .64<=h<=2.25 has A>=1+9/100000.

L_JENSEN.statement: Convexity of f_J converts arclength-mean flux into the G-weighted area-coordinate lower bound.

L_BASELINE.statement: The three planar types and monotonicity of G give A-1>=B(h)+ell(s-t).

L_BOTTOM_CALIBRATION.statement: Each complementary-corner extent satisfies hs>=(1-s)/L+pi L/4 and controls its corresponding strip orientation.

L_STRIP_GAIN.statement: On the placed capped area interval, every planar type and either strip orientation satisfy p^2>=1+c delta^2 H.

L_COEFFICIENT.statement: The G derivative estimate and exact H moments dominate C0(h)=min(.134h^3,.36).

L_AREA_GAIN.statement: The explicit slice hypotheses imply A-1>=B(h), and A-1>=B(h)+S(h) on the central interval.

L_BASELINE_SEMICONCAVITY.statement: The layer-cake baseline has upper second derivative 2/a^2 on [a,b], including selected-branch switches.

L_GAIN_SEMICONCAVITY.statement: S has upper second derivative .4, including caps, coefficient switches and changes of minimizing y.

L_CAPPED_FORMULA.statement: The capped gain equals the minimum of the cap and the uncapped critical value even when one displayed candidate is infeasible.

L_FORMAL_ALGEBRA.statement: Positive quadratic-plus-capped-cubic objectives have the exact global minimum with lower bound and attainment; concavity after subtracting Kx^2/2 gives the closed-interval loss K(b-a)^2/8.

L_EXACT_KNOTS.statement: Outward integer arithmetic proves all 24 baseline knot bounds, 16 gain bounds, Taylor errors and 23 rational interpolation margins.

L_SCALAR_CONTINUUM.statement: B or B+S, as appropriate, is uniformly at least 9/100000 on the entire claimed curvature interval.
